product_name: Cybex E-Gazelle S Electric Single to Double Pushchair- Moon Black - Moon Black

product_name: Cybex Base T (isofix base for Cloud T & Sirona T)
description: Experience effortless installation and enhanced safety with the Cybex Base T for i-Size compatible with the Cybex Cloud T and Sirona T. By providing a stable and secure base for your Cloud T or Sirona T, it ensures that your little one is protected during every car journey. Cybex commitment to safety, simplicity, and convenience makes the Base T the perfect choice for hassle-free travels with your child.    Choose Cybex Base T and enjoy a seamless installation experience, simplified by optimized ISOFIX release buttons. The rotation mechanism adds a new level of convenience, allowing you to effortlessly place your child in or take them out of the car seat. Prioritize your child's safety and your own peace of mind with our Base T.

product_name: Cybex Cloud T i-Size Car Seat- Sepia Black Plus
description: The Cybex Cloud T i-Size Plus Car Seat in Sepia Black Plus is suitable from birth, providing both comfort and safety for your growing baby up until around 24 months. When used with the ISOFIX Base T, you can enjoy the benefits of an in-car recline position for a comfortable ride every time.    Plus, by turning the infant car seat towards the car door, it's easy to on and off-board your little one due to its 180 rotation. To provide extra leg support, the recline hinges at the hip area and also create a longer seating position for extra space. This makes it one of the longest infant carriers available on the market. The all-around air ventilation allows for a pleasant seating temperature for your little one no matter their age or season.    The Cloud T i-Size Car Seat boasts safe security features, and exceptional flexibility and could be just what you're looking for when travelling with your little one. Whether it’s short trips around town or long car rides across the country, bring them along, safely with comfortable journeys in mind.    The Plus fabric also features mesh inserts for even better air circulation and comfort, proper circulation of air not only reduces humidity but also prevents any excess moisture. Its specially designed 3D mesh structure improves breathability by up to six times*, ensuring that your child stays cool and comfortable no matter the weather.    Please note: The Cloud T fits on the Z2 base as well as the T base, however, Base T is only fit for the T range and is not compatible with any other car seats. product_name: Cybex Base G3
description: Getting your child in or out of the car was never so easy than with the Base G! One pull of the rotation handle turns the seat towards the car door and releases it simultaneously. Both the Cloud G i-Size baby car seat and the Sirona G i-Size toddler car seats fit the Base G, providing the flexibility and longevity you need with a growing child.
